# Real anonymized evidence

This directory contains provider-shaped examples derived from an authorized
GitHub read-only collection. Repository identity, refs, URLs, user identities,
application metadata and signed query strings are replaced before the example
is committed. The provenance record names the source receipt and the fields
that were transformed.

The anonymized bundle is suitable for replay and evaluation; it must not be
described as a current live provider receipt. The live receipt is kept under
`../live/` and remains time-bound evidence.
